basis: One representative valid NIFTY snapshot closest to 14:00 JST on regular NSE trading days

policy.selection: smallest absolute NIFTY quote-time distance from 14:00; later quote wins an exact tie

policy.external_data: stored as reference only; never blocks the 14:00 save
